issue.title: test_memory_plan_renders_glossary_terms_block_in_tier2 fails on master: asserts unwrapped 'Aliases follow in parentheses.' against wrapped Tier 2 output

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic and static: the assertion compares a fixed literal against text rendered from a fixed in-repo template, with no timing, ordering, concurrency, or I/O involved. Reproduced twice on the same clean tree at HEAD af951d1f9 — once inside the full parallel 'just test' run and once in isolation with '-p no:randomly' (2.34s, same AssertionError, same wrapped text). git log -S confirms the assertion and the rendered string were introduced together by 445afde7c, so it has been failing since that commit rather than intermittently.
